metainfo: No *_metainfo.json in pinned local generation repository. No per-episode demo ID/initial scene state in archived RLDS metadata. No new replay or environment-version search.

phases.source: env.step(action) precedes obs append; saved states indexed at corresponding pre-action index
phases.regenerated: set orig_states[0]; 10 settling actions; filter noops without executing; record obs then execute retained action
phases.initial_exception: regenerated states[0] copies original state before settling; its first obs is after settling. Do not equate these fields.
